_meta.stability: Frozen for the weft-generation lifetime per ADR-002. Shape additions that preserve wire compatibility (new optional response fields) are allowed; breaking changes require a new generation.
_meta.relation_to_classic: Same request shape; response shape changes from IssueDict to IssueWeft.

shape_decl.request_type: {actor?: str, if_held?: bool, expected_assignee?: str, reason?: str, override?: bool}
shape_decl.rationale: Releases a claim. Holder-checked: the live assignee must equal expected_assignee, else actor; any other holder is 409 CONFLICT and the claim is left alone. override: true is the coordinator release (recorded as a released_by_override event; an explicit expected_assignee is still enforced). An issue nobody holds is idempotent: 200 with the unchanged issue. if_held is still accepted for wire compatibility but no longer changes behaviour (holder-checked release is the only mode). 404 NOT_FOUND when the issue id does not exist.
